{"id":"mimid-1wgh.37.111","title":"draft-atwood-mimi-calls: nothing in MIMI says a call is live","description":"Found 2026-11-23 while deciding how a client reaches a call (bead
mimid-1wgh.114.1), and it is the reason that bead was first written
wrongly.

THE GAP. Three drafts each hold a piece of a MIMI call, and none of them
signals that a call is happening:

- room-policy-04 §5 gives the STRUCTURE: a parent-dependent room, and its
  own note offers that shape "for room used for a multi-media call of
  clients in a Group DM".
- mimi-content-10 §5.10 gives an EXTERNAL URL: "Joining a conference via
  an external URL is possible", and then puts "further discussion of
  calling and conferencing functionality" out of scope.
- draft-atwood-mimi-calls gives the KEYS: media_secret from the call
  room's own epoch.

Nothing says "there is a call live in room X right now". A client that
joins a parent-dependent room learns it is a child of a chat and cannot
tell whether that is a call in progress, a call that ended an hour ago,
or a persistent sub-room that is not a call at all.

THE CONSEQUENCE, which is how it was found: an implementer reaching for a
way to announce a call finds only §5.10's url field, and §5.10 is about
external services. Putting a mimi:// room URI there looks standard and is
understood by nobody. The absence of the right field pushes implementers
into misusing the wrong one, and that is worth saying.

WHAT MIMID WILL DO MEANWHILE (decision on bead mimid-1wgh.114.1): a
mimi-content extensions-map key, private use per §4.3 ("Negative integer
and text string keys are only for private use"), on an ordinary message
in the parent chat, so a human reads a sentence and a client that knows
the key offers to join. Same shape as the provisional component id of
decision mimid-1wgh.112.

WHAT THE DRAFT SHOULD SAY: that the signal is missing, what mimid uses
provisionally, and an IANA request for a MIMI Content Extension Key
(§8.2.1's registry, positive integers under Expert Review) so it stops
being private use. The draft already carries exactly this shape of
request for the media_keys ComponentID, so the section has a model to
follow.

SCOPE CHECK BEFORE WRITING: the draft is about where media keys come
from. A liveness signal is signalling, not keying, and §5.10 declares
calling out of scope for mimi-content. So this may belong in the calls
draft as a short section, or may be a second document. Mark's call. What
it must NOT be is silent: the gap is what made the first design wrong.

NO JMAP in any of it (memory no-jmap-to-the-mimi-wg).

{"notes":"mimid's provisional signal is decided: decision mimid-1wgh.116, the private-use text extension key "draft-atwood-mimi-calls/call". So the draft's IANA section has something concrete to describe and to request a positive integer for, alongside the ComponentID request it already carries.
Liveness semantics decided for mimid: mimid-1wgh.117. The announcement is an invitation, not a live indicator, because a non-member of the call room cannot learn its membership and MIMI offers no way to ask. If the draft describes the signal, it should say that too: the gap is not just "there is no field", it is that remote liveness needs a heartbeat nobody has specified, and a reader who assumes otherwise builds a live badge that lies.
MARK DECIDED 2026-11-23: a short section in draft-atwood-mimi-calls, plus
an extension-key request in the IANA section that already requests the
media_keys ComponentID.

WHAT THE SECTION MUST DO, and no more:
- state the gap: room-policy-04 §5 gives the structure, mimi-content-10
  §5.10 gives an external URL and then declares calling out of scope, and
  this document gives the keys; nothing says a call is live in room X;
- say that a reader reaching for §5.10's url field for an in-MIMI call is
  misusing it, because §5.10 is about external conference services and a
  mimi:// room URI has no defined join behaviour. Say it because that is
  the mistake the absence of a field produces -- it is the mistake this
  implementation made first (bead mimid-1wgh.114.1);
- define the announcement: a mimi-content extensions-map key naming the
  call room, private use today (decision mimid-1wgh.116), with the
  meaning of decision mimid-1wgh.117 -- an INVITATION, not a liveness
  indicator. Say why: a non-member of the call room cannot learn its
  membership and MIMI offers no way to ask, so remote liveness needs a
  heartbeat this document does not specify and a reader who assumes
  otherwise builds a live badge that lies;
- request a MIMI Content Extension Key from §8.2.1's registry (positive
  integers, Expert Review), in the same shape as the ComponentID request
  already there.

WHAT IT MUST NOT DO:
- specify a signalling protocol. That design exists already on the JMAP
  side, where a call object carries a server-enforced state machine, and
  it is not this document's and not the WG's business.
- mention JMAP at all (memory no-jmap-to-the-mimi-wg).

THE SCOPE OBJECTION, answered in the draft rather than left for a
reviewer to raise: the document is titled "Media Keys for Calls" and an
announcement is not keying. The keys are unusable if nothing can tell a
client a call exists, so the announcement is the minimum needed to use
them. Frame it that way in the section's first sentence.

NOT CHOSEN: a second draft (same audience, same author, twice the
maintenance, for one key and a paragraph); an issue against mimi-content
with no draft text (§5.10 has already declared calling out of scope, so
it likely gets that answer again, and there would still be nowhere to
request the key).

WRITING IT NEEDS MARK'S OK, like any change to his I-D repo, and the
-00.xml must be regenerated with it so the markdown and the built
artifact do not disagree."}
